# SQL Injection Payloads
# Categories: union-based, tautology, stacked queries, blind/time-based
# These lines are detector test inputs; each is fed to the scanner, never executed.

# === Tautology / Auth Bypass ===
' OR 1=1 --
' OR '1'='1' --
admin' --
' OR ''=' --
1' OR 'x'='x
1' OR 0=0 --
' OR 1=1 /*
' OR 1=2 --

# === Stacked Queries ===
1; DROP TABLE users --
1; DELETE FROM users WHERE 1=1 --
admin'; DROP TABLE users; --
1; INSERT INTO users VALUES('x','y'); --

# === Union-based ===
1' UNION SELECT NULL --
1' UNION SELECT NULL, NULL --
1' UNION SELECT version() --
